newsitem.title: USA: Visa, Marriott to develop travel products.
newsitem.headline: Visa, Marriott to develop travel products.

text.p: Visa U.S.A. and Marriott Hotels Resorts and Suites said Wednesday they have reached an agreement to develop a variety of products and services for travelers.
The companies said they plan to pursue development of programs such as new chip card technology and a cooperative database, research on travel trends, travel agency programs, and brand advertising.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed. It was described in a news release as being a "multimillion-dollar" agreement over "several years."
Marriott Hotels, Resorts and Suites is one of six lodging brands operated by Marriott International Inc.
Visa is a financial services company owned by a consortium of banks.
